documents.title: Recover access after key loss
documents.body: Use a verified recovery code, revoke the missing security key, and enroll a replacement.

documents.title: Retry a signed webhook
documents.body: Preserve the event identifier and signature while retrying a failed webhook delivery.

documents.title: Correct an invoice address
documents.body: Update the legal billing address and regenerate the affected invoice document.

documents.title: Restore project attachments
documents.body: Restore attachments from the same recovery snapshot as the project history.

documents.title: Validate SSO group mapping
documents.body: Test mapped administrator and viewer groups before enforcing single sign-on.

documents.title: Confirm regional migration
documents.body: Compare object totals and checksums before switching the active data region.

documents.title: Repair a report schedule
documents.body: Set the intended timezone and verify the next recurring delivery timestamp.

documents.title: Remove a suppressed recipient
documents.body: Confirm consent and remove the address from the appropriate email suppression entry.

documents.title: Audit a service credential
documents.body: Review scope, last use, owner, and expiration before rotating the service credential.

documents.title: Verify a backup manifest
documents.body: Match object counts and hashes against the source inventory and signed backup manifest.

documents.title: Test an allowlist change
documents.body: Validate office and automation access before enforcing the revised IP allowlist.

documents.title: Publish corrected release notes
documents.body: Verify incident links, corrected rollout dates, and customer support references.
